attribution.text: We acknowledge the Community Coordinated Modeling Center (CCMC) at Goddard Space Flight Center for the use of DONKI, https://ccmc.gsfc.nasa.gov/tools/DONKI/

provenance.notes: This source calls the CCMC directly (ccmc.gsfc.nasa.gov/DONKI-API/get/, no key), not api.nasa.gov: the api.nasa.gov figures (authentication page, read 2026-11-10: DEMO_KEY 30 requests an hour and 50 a day per IP address; own key 1,000 an hour per key across all api.nasa.gov APIs) do not apply to it; a DEMO_KEY call to api.nasa.gov/DONKI that day answered X-RateLimit-Limit: 10. The CCMC pages read (DONKI tool page, DONKI API page, data policy, publication policy) publish no rate; a call to the CCMC endpoint answered X-Rate-Limit-Remaining: 119 (an unpublished window). Rules of the Road: event and validation studies with DONKI data to be done with the CCMC's knowledge and collaboration; real-time data is prototyping quality; acknowledge the CCMC in publications (publication policy, a request for publications). No licence stated. Contact: the DONKI curator.
